content: This medication may contain inactive ingredients that could potentially cause allergic reactions or other complications. Inform your doctor if you have any allergies before starting this medication. This drug can cause dizziness or impair your alertness. Consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) while on this medication may exacerbate these effects. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring full alertness until you are certain you can do so safely. Do not consume alcoholic beverages while taking this medication unless explicitly approved by your doctor. Alcohol consumption during treatment may lead to rapid heartbeat and skin flushing. This medication can increase your sensitivity to sunlight. Limit your time in the sun, avoid tanning booths and sunlamps, and use sunscreen and protective clothing when outdoors. If you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, inform your doctor. You should not become pregnant while using griseofulvin, as it may harm an unborn baby. Discuss reliable birth control methods with your doctor while using this medication and for one month after your last dose. If you become pregnant, contact your doctor immediately to discuss the risks and benefits of continuing this medication. The effects of this drug on human sperm are not well understood. However, based on animal studies, it is recommended to wait for a period of time after completing treatment with griseofulvin before attempting to father a child. It is unknown whether this medication passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before breastfeeding while on this medication. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may reduce the effectiveness of hormonal birth control methods such as pills, patches, or rings, potentially leading to pregnancy. Discuss with your doctor or pharmacist whether you should use additional reliable backup birth control methods while taking this medication. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911 in the U.S.) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. Do not use it for other conditions unless directed by your doctor. While taking this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., kidney/liver function tests, complete blood count) should be performed to monitor your progress and check for side effects. Keep all medical and lab appointments. Ask your doctor or pharmacist about ways to manage the infection and prevent reinfection. Fungal infections spread easily in warm, moist environments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
